company_description: Ball Corporation is a leading global supplier of sustainable aluminum packaging for the beverage industry. It manufactures aluminum beverage cans, bottles and cups for beverage, personal care and household-product customers worldwide. Following the 2024 sale of its aerospace business to BAE Systems, Ball is a pure-play aluminum packaging company. It reports three beverage packaging segments by region: North and Central America (its largest segment), Europe (EMEA) and South America (Brazil, Argentina, Chile and Paraguay). Aluminum cans are positioned as an infinitely recyclable alternative to plastic.

_validation: EXTRACTION verbatim 10-K BALL (BALL_2026-02-19 FY2025 + BALL_2024-02-20). Exercice calendaire (clos fin decembre). Aucun chiffre invente.

HERO Beverage Packaging North and Central America Net Sales : chiffre d'affaires segment 2021-2025 (5.856 / 6.696 / 5.963 / 5.619 / 6.286 Mds $) verifie sur la note Segment Information des 10-K successifs.

Beverage Packaging Europe / South America Net Sales : note Segment Information, 5 ans 2021-2025. Structure recastee apres la cession des activites europeennes Benepack (FY21-22 depuis BALL_2024-02-20, FY23-25 depuis BALL_2026-02-19).
North and Central America / Europe Comparable Operating Earnings : note Segment Information (segment earnings before restructuring and other activities), 5 ans 2021-2025.
Aerospace : segment cede a BAE Systems en fevrier 2024, exclu (active abandonnee), non retenu comme KPI.

CONTROLE contamination : aucun KPI egal au chiffre d'affaires total consolide. Hero = segment Amerique du Nord et centrale (6.29 Mds $) different du total et des autres segments. Aucune duplication d'historique.
